open_points.subject: context / Room lifecycle
open_points.text: A room is created in a project and listed; it is never renamed or removed. The owner, before making the export on the VPS (R0-72), corrects there every room name of the projects to be picked that breaks this rule (owner, 2026-11-23, State 0 round-59 T1).
open_points.question: Is the pre-export correction an explicit exception that renames an existing Room while preserving its room_id, or does the rule that a Room is never renamed also prohibit this correction?
options: Allow one pre-export rename of the existing VPS Room, preserving its room_id
Keep Room immutable and replace or exclude the offending Room by a separately defined migration action
Keep Room immutable and make the affected project ineligible for import
open_points.default_guess: Allow a one-time pre-export rename that preserves the room_id, and state this migration exception in the Room lifecycle.

witness.initial: A VPS project selected for import has a Room whose existing name identifies a person's health or needs.
events: The owner prepares that project for the one-time export.
The owner applies the instruction to correct every offending room name.
The export is imported into production with room identities kept.
outcomes: R0-96 requires the existing room name to be corrected before export and the corrected name to be imported.
R0-10 and M03 require the room never to be renamed, so its original name must remain.
witness.observer: The owner reading the room on the VPS and the agent reading the imported room in production

open_points.subject: context / pre-export room-name correction
open_points.text: So the owner, before making the export on the VPS (R0-72), corrects there every room name of the projects to be picked that breaks this rule (owner, 2026-11-23, State 0 round-59 T1).
open_points.question: What product action changes the room name, and does it change the persisted VPS Room or only the value placed in the migration export?
options: A temporary owner-facing correction action mutates the persisted VPS Room
The one-time migration script rewrites the exported copy without changing the VPS Room
The owner changes the VPS store out of band before running the export script
open_points.default_guess: Make the one-time migration script rewrite the exported copy under the owner's explicit mapping, without adding a general Room rename action.

witness.initial: A selected VPS project contains an offending room name.
events: The owner corrects the name before producing the migration file.
The owner later reads the source instance and imports the file.
outcomes: The correction mutates the source Room, so the corrected name is visible on the VPS before and after export.
The correction changes only the export, so the VPS Room retains its old name while production receives the corrected name.
witness.observer: The owner comparing the VPS project with the imported production project
